title: Compliance and Safeguarding Skills
description: This module supports practitioners to interpret safeguarding requirements, identify bias and discrimination risks, and respond in culturally safe ways. It focuses on child safe standards, practical policy use, and reflective decision-making that protects children and families.
outcomes: Apply child safe standards to everyday service delivery and decision-making
Recognise bias and discrimination risks that can affect assessments, documentation, and referrals
Use policies and procedures in culturally safe ways that strengthen child wellbeing and accountability
